svg.text: Defense in Depth: No Single Layer Is Enough
1. CSRF token - synchronizer token, tied to the session, checked on every request
2. SameSite=Strict/Lax on the session cookie - defense in depth, not the only layer
3. Origin/Referer check as a fallback - reject when neither header is trustworthy
XSS defeats all three: a script running on your own page needs no cross-site request.
